hero.bio_p1: As a Junior Developer, my curiosity defines me. I specialize in building dynamic web applications using cutting-edge technologies, but my true driver is innovation: I am currently designing solutions focused on the practical application of AI.
hero.bio_p2: I believe a great application requires a rock-solid foundation, which is why I’ve dedicated much of my training to container orchestration. I navigate comfortably through Kubernetes ecosystems, optimizing infrastructures across flavors like OpenShift and VMware. I am always on the hunt for the next technological challenge that allows me to keep evolving and delivering value to the dev community.
